notes: Runtime rebinding only; ms_ecpa/ and tests/ untouched; restore in finally blocks; per-point A=0/B=U(T) rebind represents the quadratic U_hs(T) exactly.
NaCl-only: no H2-K/Ca/Mg/SO4 energies exist in Coelho 2025; guard refuses such feeds.
Peneloux differs (his constant salt shift vs our per-ion T-linear); volume translation does not affect VLE compositions, only densities.
V3 is model-to-model: no experimental H2-CO2-brine ternary data exists on disk; targets are F. M. Coelho's own HCB .dat model curves, parameterized by the water-free gas CO2 fraction Yc_fw.
